stops.name: Colle del Lis
stops.detail: The natural park includes the north-western and south-western slopes of Mount Arpone, to the east of Colle del Lis (1,310 m) and upstream of the access road to the sanctuary of the Madonna della Bassa (1,157 m), which represents its extreme southern limit.

stops.name: centro visite
stops.detail: In the hamlet of Favella di Rubiana, the visitor center (or "House of the Park") is located.

stops.name: monte Arpone
stops.detail: The slopes of Mount Arpone included in the park appear rather wide and rounded and are scattered with boulders.

stops.name: santuario della Madonna della Bassa
stops.detail: Three annual processions climb to the sanctuary of the Madonna della Bassa in June, August, and September; the one in August starts from Mompellato and is the most important.

stops.name: Colle della Portia
stops.detail: Within the park territory, there are several hiking itineraries and a short cross-country ski trail that leads from Colle del Lis towards Colle della Portia.
